subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the highest life expectancy at birth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Life expectancy at birth** is the average number of years that a newborn could expect to live.
 
• According to the **SRS (Sample Registration System) report**, **Kerala** has the highest life expectancy at birth.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** had the **lowest life expectancy** at birth.
 
• The SRS report is released by **Registrar General & Census Commissioner**, which works under the Home Ministry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
